purpose: Qualify the geometry of real-data-informed rare biological synthetic challenges before any model fitting. V1 production outcomes were non-gating calibration only and cannot satisfy this contract.

realization.fit_truth_blinding: Challenge kind/regime, R and pseudo-rare truth remain controller-only. Fit view receives observations plus source/donor/entity codes only.

challenge_semantics.rna_recoverable: STAT1-like donor-structured program with canonical RNA effect and same-nucleus ATAC support.
challenge_semantics.teacher_private: Same latent/regulatory geometry but RNA effect scaled to 0.15 of canonical while ATAC remains strong; this is a designed identifiability stress condition, not a measured biological effect-size claim.
challenge_semantics.separate_nucleus: Independent RNA and ATAC nuclei share donor-level prevalence but never cell identity.
challenge_semantics.technical_twin: R is exactly zero; observation-side pseudo-rarity is prevalence-matched and intentionally tempting.

evidence_ladder.rule: Nested fixed gene order seeded at 8100; higher evidence adds genes rather than swapping subsets.

depth_ladder.rule: Nested deterministic thinning seeded at 9100; depth changes measurement of the same biology.

extreme_regime: REPORT_ONLY except structural validity: biological worlds must contain at least one R-positive cell and technical twin must keep R=0.

fixture_qualification.design_calibration: 100-seed prospective calibration was used only before gate freeze to ensure intended geometry is estimable; no V2 realization truth was opened.
